correctness.rationale: For the labelled GP(10,2) dodecahedron, every binary colouring must frustrate at least six edges because each of 12 pentagons has a monochromatic edge and each edge borders two faces. Recolouring 3-sites by the lesser common-colour neighbor class raises bond penalty by at most one per site, yielding b+k>=6. The cyclic 81-state transfer trace exactly enumerates sectors b+k=6 and proper-colouring coefficients; the inspected independent DFS enumerator is structurally distinct. The sector vector (250,3000,13800,30400,32760,15840,2720) sums to 98770 and independently computed mean/variance are 34836/9877 and 119729580/97555129. The fixed finite energy gap gives compact-uniform x crossover P(exp(-x)), so mathematics is valid.
